design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (prescription_fills_and_refills, category rx)

[Step 0 — draw] `draw_counts.py <diff> --task 0` printed {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 6]}. Assignment: rx_ext_vacation_override_days (root) = 6 factors, rx_ext_strength_error_remake_units = 5, rx_ext_open_balance_decline_credit = 5. `--tasks 2` shows task 1 draws 2 prerequisite problems with [4, 6, 5].

[Step 0 — pre-check and scope] Base rx charter checked: rx_refill carries rx_evt_early_fill_exceptions.police_report_stated, a caller_statement gate whose correlation key is the internal prescription id, so no persona can satisfy it; it is superseded clause-by-clause by task 1's lost-or-stolen policy (overwrite of the police-report sentence), which retires it for every refill. rx_discontinued, rx_transferred_out, rx_expired (refill unenrolment trigger) and rx_error_return (rewards goodwill trigger) write into other categories through their triggers, so no tool books them; rx_return_to_stock is avoided (insurance trigger). The only rx event the patient performs in person is declining an owed balance (base: 'declined by the patient'), so every task's user-owned problem is a decline; the charter splits it by class (non-controlled here, controlled in task 1, where base already treats controlled balances differently). Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: vacation override refill days (rx_refill), strength-error remake units (rx_error_remake, wrong_strength only), non-controlled decline credit (rx_balance_cancelled) and tools record_vacation_override_refill_9f5a083e, dispense_strength_error_remake_b4449648, decline_owed_balance_20c85924 (owner=user). Left for task 1: lost-or-stolen replacement (rx_refill, lost_or_stolen_replacement), label-error remake (wrong_directions_label), controlled decline credit — a full three-problem tree on a Schedule V prescription with its own user write.

[Design thesis] Surface goal: 'I leave Saturday for a long trip, fill my losartan early'. Core scored parameter: days_supply_dispensed of the vacation override. Hidden chain: the prescription's September 15 refill (a) was confirmed as the wrong strength on 2026-09-23 and has no remake, (b) was dispensed short with 60 units still owed. The vacation-override rule says the refill 'is not dispensed until each confirmed dispensing-error report on the prescription has a corrected remake booked against it on the fill ledger' and its days supply 'is fixed only after the prescription's fill ledger shows no owed balance still open'. Depth: 2 hops (remake, decline) before the root; breadth: coverage plan class, delivery plan, paused auto refill, 12-month refill history, pickup dates, owed-balance ledger, error-report ledger, Savings Club membership.

[Problem-tree card]
root rx_ext_vacation_override_days (agent, record_vacation_override_refill_9f5a083e)
 edge 1 -> rx_ext_open_balance_decline_credit: kind value_input, gate owed_days, form state, sentence 'The vacation override days supply is fixed only after the prescription's fill ledger shows no owed balance still open, every short fill's owed units having been completed or cancelled.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; waits on a record-visible state (no open owed balance on the fill ledger); names no tool/id/code token; scope = every owed balance on the prescription, hard requirement. The one write in this difficulty that produces a cancellation of a non-controlled balance is the patient's decline (the controlled decline policy applies to controlled classes only; balance completion has no policy/tool here), resolved_by decline_owed_balance_20c85924 (owner user). False at opening: initial_state.rx_fills.180e6d0c-8573-4886-92c2-c05c039ff3d6.owed_units = 60 with no completion/cancellation naming it; rx_prescriptions.3b749a86-8b88-4fe1-9610-7abd5da2ae9d.owed_quantity = 60. Derivation: sentence + ledger (60 owed from 2026-09-15) + the decline rule ('the balance itself is cancelled for its full owed units') -> the decline.
 edge 2 -> rx_ext_strength_error_remake_units: kind state_gate, gate rx_fills.error_report_id, form state, sentence 'A vacation override refill is not dispensed until each confirmed dispensing-error report on the prescription has a corrected remake booked against it on the fill ledger.' Four-point test passes (connective 'not ... until', negated direction chosen because a release waits on something standing; the other edge uses the affirmative 'fixed only after' for a figure). Only the strength-error remake policy books a remake for a wrong_strength report. False at opening: rx_error_reports.e7150ffd-aa33-4bc6-91ed-62c36f2b9b6f.review_outcome = confirmed and the only remake 6729495a-1339-4c05-af3f-4305dbabece1 names d7674780-70a1-47a7-b1a0-21878812b8e1.
 topological order: remake, decline (parallel, commute — swapped replay gives identical hash 5d1ad8670f23…), vacation override. Owner=user problem: the decline.
 Deletion sensitivity (verify.py): skip decline -> root 10 instead of 39; skip remake -> root stays 39 but the remake entry is missing from the terminal state (state_gate).
 user_scenario mentions neither the owed balance nor the report except inside 'If the agent tells/explains …' reactions; tools validate nothing (no Error branches).

[Base-invariant card]
 rx_refill (step 16): refill_only_when_active — P0 status active; refill_available — refills_remaining 1 (refills_authorized 4, three refills used); refill_within_validity — written 2026-01-12 + 365 = 2027-01-12 >= 2026-09-24 (just-before/at-boundary cases in temporal_feasibility); refill_not_too_soon — routine-only: most recent dispensed fill 2026-09-15 (30 days) gives eligible date 2026-10-09, a routine refill would be refused, the vacation override is exempt; rx_evt_early_fill_exceptions — vacation_override_allowed true, rx_msr_vacation_overrides_365d = 1 < 2, 39 <= 90; police gate retired by the task-1 overwrite.
 rx_error_remake (step 12): error_confirmed — ER0 review_outcome confirmed.

[Business-object card] Object: prescription 3b749a86-8b88-4fe1-9610-7abd5da2ae9d (losartan 50 mg tablet, rx 1583204). Short fill f3 96fcb0e6-344a-440e-8968-574f0fd515a0 (2026-09-15, 30 of 90, pay 11.99 discount_program) with owed entry p3 180e6d0c-8573-4886-92c2-c05c039ff3d6 (60). Error reports: ER0 e7150ffd-aa33-4bc6-91ed-62c36f2b9b6f (wrong_strength on f3, confirmed 2026-09-23, unanswered) and ERold d7674780-70a1-47a7-b1a0-21878812b8e1 (label report on f1, answered by remake 6729495a-1339-4c05-af3f-4305dbabece1) — ERold is excluded from the remake by its answered status and by error_type. The decline writes source_fill_id = p3; the remake writes error_report_id = ER0 and source_fill_id = f3.

[Factor card] (tier taken; evidence rows; baseline figure of result)
 V1 vacation_ceiling (parameter, cross-difficulty coverage; both conditions read one plan record, so it is not counted as multi-source): Part D Standard 24f3ef40-34c7-4e51-a4cf-595675259d20 allows 1 override/plan year and 90-day claims -> 60; baseline 90 -> 69.

 R1 replaced_units_basis (method): report 4 days after pickup -> 26; baseline 30 -> 39. Near-miss: the 2-day review lag is not the tier used because the report itself was late.
 R2 remake_waiting_allowance: 1 day -> 1 -> 37.  R3 short_fill_allowance: 60 >= 30 -> 3 -> 35.  R4 strength_continuity_allowance: 1 refill left -> 3 -> 35.  R5 strength_pause_allowance (cross-category refill): pause 82 days -> 5 -> 33. Whole baseline 30; result 38 (R1 baseline gives 42).
 D1 undelivered_value_method (method, cross-difficulty copay): discount_program + active Savings Club 5c6bae06-c49c-4fae-b8d8-5d958872c866 value list 5.99 -> 6.00; baseline units 7.9933 -> 9.24.
 D2 handling_amount: 9 days -> 1.00 -> 8.25.  D3 repeat_short_recovery: 2 owed entries (p2 near-miss is settled but still counts as booked) -> 1.00 -> 6.25.  D4 tenure_amount: 4 fills -> 0.25 -> 7.00.  D5 short_fill_error_amount: ER0 confirmed on f3 -> 1.00 -> 6.25. Whole baseline 7.99.
 Base boundaries inherited: every base eligibility above; the only overwrite is the decline credit replacing 'a fill that was dispensed correctly is never taken back or refunded, whatever the reason the patient gives.' of rx_evt_dispensing_error (declared). No stamp field decides any tier.

[Seed] 1 customer, 1 store, 1 prescriber, 1 prescription, 13 fill-ledger rows (history_rows touched 24 across computations), 2 error reports, Part D coverage, Savings Club enrollment, Mail Delivery plan, paused Auto Refill 90-Day enrollment. Each cross row is read by a factor; removing it changes a factor (see factor card). Automatic clauses: p3's completion window runs to 2026-09-29 (no lapse owed at frozen time); no fill waits in will-call (all picked up) so no return to stock is owed; refills remain so no renewal is owed; prescription not near expiry.

[Persona] Beatrice Achterberg, polite and hurried; volunteers only the travel refill; gives phone to locate, DOB when asked; ZIP/email/rx number/return date only when asked; decline reaction and user-tool execution only after the agent explains; closes when told the refill is booked. No numbers of any answer appear.

[Standard solution] locate (phone) -> verify (DOB + phone) -> read prescriptions, fills, error reports, coverage, copay, delivery, refill enrollment, store, prescriber -> remake 38 -> hand over decline, patient runs it with 7.25 -> vacation override 39.

[Verification] scratch verify.py re-implements the handling-time replay with the real tools and the check_compute evaluator; output: remake result=38 (factor baselines 42/37/35/35/33, all 30); decline 7.25 (9.24/8.25/6.25/7.0/6.25, all 7.99); vacation 39 (69/54/41/32/32/36, all 69; skip decline 10; skip remake 39). Gates run: check_extended/task_tools/replay/solvability/compute/grounding/cross_fire --task 0 all OK (see final report).

[Draft recomputation from visible context] Using only KB prose, tool schemas, finder returns and the persona: the travel request selects a vacation override; its policy text names two waits (confirmed report without remake -> remake; open owed balance -> decline, which the patient performs); the numbers above follow from the stated ladders; no second reading of the order or values was found.

[Revisions] r1: `in (...)` tuple in the release ladder rejected by the grammar -> rewritten as two equality tests. r2: a module-level helper in task_tools.py counted as an unnamed tool -> inlined. r3: added argument_uniqueness_tracing for all three calls.

[Round 2 rework — audit policy_task r1 items G-1, G-3, G-4, G-5, G-6, T0-1..T0-4]
 G-1 / T0-1 symptom: vacation rule promised a cap at vacation_override_max_days that compute lacked. Change: result = MN(P('vacation_override_max_days'), …) and the rule's closing sentence plus compute_basis now state 'the total is held to no more than the class's vacation_override_max_days'. Re-run: 39 (cap does not bind; the generic 100-day case now gives 90).
 G-3 / T0-2 symptom: on-hand anchor read the latest pickup of any fill. Change: new binding last_refill_fill; last_pickup_date filters source_fill_id = the most recent refill. Re-run: 39 unchanged on this world.
 G-4 / G-6 / T0-3 symptom: the decline method's cash tier equalled the unit proportion. Change: tier 2 is now 'billed to insurance under an active Commercial Copay Plan -> patient pay x copay_week_days per whole week of owed therapy / days_supply' (a genuinely different method, cross-category coverage). Tiers 1 and 2 each combine the fill's payment basis with a record of another product, so undelivered_value_method is the task's multi-source factor. On this world the short fill is a discount-program fill and the plan is Part D, so tier 1 still applies: 7.25 unchanged.
 G-5 / T0-4 symptom: release-channel and repeat-error allowances sized a remake on non-clinical grounds. Change: both struck; replaced by strength_continuity_allowance (refills left: 0 -> 5 days, 1 -> 3, more -> 0; the patient needs therapy to continue up to a renewal) and strength_pause_allowance (paused automated refill enrollment, no automated cycle will follow). Seed change for the continuity tier: refills_authorized 4 (was 5), refills_remaining 1, refills_remaining_after 4/3/2/1 on f0..f3. Re-run (verify.py): remake 38, factor baselines 42/37/35/35/33, all-baseline 30; decline unchanged; vacation 39 unchanged, skip decline 10, skip remake 39; swapped prerequisite order gives the identical hash 79f2f3a0….
 Propagation: computations[0] expected/factor_trace/factor_sensitivity, the remake call argument and tracing, seed_consistency texts, order_uniqueness, edge_load_bearing and this dossier.
user_scenario:
You are Beatrice Achterberg, 68, a retired school librarian in Seattle who speaks in full, polite sentences and apologises for being in a hurry. You are calling Kestrel Pharmacy because you fly out on Saturday to stay with your daughter in Lisbon for about eleven weeks, and you want your blood pressure pill, losartan 50 mg, refilled today as a travel supply so you do not run out while you are away. You open with exactly that: you are leaving on Saturday for a long trip and you need your losartan filled early to take with you. You would like the pharmacy to take care of the refill for you; you are not asking for anything else and you do not know how the pharmacy works out how much it can give you.

To find you, you give your phone number, 2065550142. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, 1958-03-04; only if they ask for more do you add your ZIP code, 98107, or your email, beatrice.achterberg@fastmail.com. If they ask for the prescription number you read it off the old label: 1583204. If they ask when you are back, you say around the twelfth of December. If they ask how you will collect it, you say you will come to the Ballard store tomorrow morning, and if they ask how you want to pay you say the same way as always.

You do not bring up anything else about your account. If the agent tells you that something from your last fill still has to be put right first, you listen and let them handle it: if it is about the tablets you phoned about on Monday because they were the wrong strength, you confirm that and say you would be glad to have the correct ones made up. If the agent explains that the rest of the September order that the store still owes you has to be either sent to you or declined before the travel supply, you say you will not be here to collect it and you would rather decline it and have the money for it back; when the agent unlocks the decline step and hands it to you with the owed-balance reference and the credit amount, you run it yourself with exactly the values they give you, and afterwards you can repeat what it showed you if asked. If a figure the agent quotes you does not match what you expected, you just ask them to double-check it against your records; you never suggest a number yourself.

Once the agent tells you the travel refill of your losartan has been booked and when it will be ready, you thank them, say you will pick it up tomorrow, and end the call.

base_preconditions.condition: A refill is dispensed only while the prescription is in active status.
A refill is dispensed only when the prescription's refills_remaining is at least 1.
A refill is dispensed no later than the date the prescriber wrote the prescription plus the prescription validity days, counted in calendar days with the written date as day 0.
A routine refill is dispensed no earlier than the refill-eligible date, which is the most recent dispensed fill of this prescription plus the refill-eligibility days.

A vacation_override refill is dispensed only where the class vacation_override_allowed is true (Non-Controlled Maintenance: true), rx_msr_vacation_overrides_365d (1) is below vacation_override_max_per_365_days (2), and the days supply is no larger than vacation_override_max_days (90), and the result is capped there; the police-report gate of this policy is superseded by the lost-or-stolen replacement policy and does not govern a vacation override.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The refill-eligibility days are the days_supply_dispensed of that most recent fill multiplied by the class's early_refill_threshold_pct and divided by 100, with any fraction of a day dropped; the fill date is day 0 and calendar days are counted.

boundary_check.at_boundary: A routine refill on 2026-10-09 (inclusive) would be allowed; on 2026-10-08 it would not.

edges.condition: Every owed-balance entry on the prescription is named as source by a balance completion or balance cancellation entry, so the owed units summed over the prescription's fill ledger are zero.
edges.policy_source: The vacation override days supply is fixed only after the prescription's fill ledger shows no owed balance still open, every short fill's owed units having been completed or cancelled.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The September 15 short fill left an owed-balance entry of 60 units that no completion or cancellation names, so the owed units summed over the ledger are 60, not zero.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The decline books a balance cancellation naming the owed-balance entry for its 60 units; the ledger sum (30 + 60 - 30 - 60) becomes 0, owed_days becomes 0 and the vacation override days supply moves from 10 to 39.

edges.condition: For every dispensing-error report on the prescription whose review_outcome is confirmed, the fill ledger holds a remake entry whose error_report_id names that report.
edges.policy_source: A vacation override refill is not dispensed until each confirmed dispensing-error report on the prescription has a corrected remake booked against it on the fill ledger.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The wrong-strength report on the September 15 refill is confirmed, and the only remake on the ledger answers the earlier March label report, so a confirmed report stands without its remake.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The remake call books an rx_error_remake entry whose error_report_id names the confirmed wrong-strength report, so every confirmed report on the prescription has its remake.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisite problems are parallel and commute: the remake quantity reads the error reports, the wrong-strength fill, its pickup entry, the owed units booked on its owed-balance entry, the refills used and the refill enrollment's pause, none of which the decline changes (the decline adds a cancellation entry and lowers owed_quantity); the decline credit reads the most recent owed-balance entry, the short fill, owed-balance and fill counts and the error reports, none of which the remake entry changes (it is neither a refill, an original fill nor an owed-balance entry). Replaying the gold with the decline before the remake (actions 13-14 before 11-12) gives the identical terminal hash 79f2f3a08fe7c58b8d872299be6ee0455d03f8747f5f46ad403ba2fa89169edd with the same arguments 38 and 7.25.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the decline the 60 owed units stay on the ledger, owed_days is 60 and the vacation override days supply recomputes to 10 instead of 39; the terminal state also lacks the cancellation entry with refund_usd 7.25.

Without the remake the terminal state lacks the rx_error_remake entry of 38 units answering the confirmed wrong-strength report, and the vacation override would be dispensed while that confirmed report stands unanswered, contrary to the prerequisite sentence (state_gate; the days supply itself stays 39).

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only the travel refill.
